requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter covers classes A1 through A4, B and C.
User prefers properties near public transport. Expression of proximity, so the threshold is the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence clearly needs nearby education services (universities, schools). Expression of proximity, so the threshold is the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type, the filterable equivalent of tipologia_bene_immobile) with surface_area of at least 850 sqm, energy class A1 through C, mobility score of at least 71, and education score of at least 75. No coordinates were supplied, so results are ordered by id. The 60-person capacity was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered.
